documented_assumptions.statement: OODA loop fully implemented and operational with session checkpointing

evidence: Deferral language in commit messages bypasses gate

documented_assumptions.statement: Memory system (STM/LTM) is fully integrated with OODA cycles

No foreign key linking LTM to CycleRecords

documented_assumptions.statement: Agent Orchestration system routes agents based on capability matching
evidence: AGENT_REGISTRY.yaml defines capability_tags for all agents
Matching logic uses tag-based capability search
gaps: Error path if no matching agent found not clear

evidence: Session resume logic covers 85% of cases
Edge cases: parallel cycles, nested OODA, interrupted writes not handled

documented_assumptions.statement: RBAC enforcement is multi-layered and comprehensive
evidence: 3-layer RBAC: GitHub App scopes + policy rules + agent capabilities

implicit_assumptions_discovered.assumption: Repository state is always consistent (no partial writes, no torn records)
implicit_assumptions_discovered.source: Code assumes atomic JSONL writes without explicit transaction control
implicit_assumptions_discovered.risk: MEDIUM - Corruption possible on power loss

implicit_assumptions_discovered.assumption: GitHub API is always available (no network partitions, no rate limiting)
implicit_assumptions_discovered.source: Agent code calls GitHub API without robust retry logic
implicit_assumptions_discovered.risk: HIGH - System fails if GitHub API unavailable

implicit_assumptions_discovered.assumption: Workflow runs to completion without interruption (no cancellation)
implicit_assumptions_discovered.source: No handling of workflow cancellation in session state
implicit_assumptions_discovered.risk: MEDIUM - State corruption if workflows cancelled

implicit_assumptions_discovered.assumption: File permissions in .codex/ are never modified (all-readable, agent-writable)
implicit_assumptions_discovered.source: No permission checks in session serializer
